_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
I {player_id} na Player i ni, {num_players}-player Liar's Dice game-ah.
Dan:
- I turn-ah, i ti thei ang:
  1) Bid thar siam ula, quantity sang zawk emaw face sang zawk (emaw pahnih) current bid aiin; '[Bid: 3, 4]' tia.
  2) Bid hnuhnung Call turin '[Call]' tiin type rawh.

I Call chuan:
  - Face value zawng zawng dice-ah a count dik tak chu bid aiin a tlem chuan, bidder hnuhnung die khat a hloh ang.
  - A nih loh chuan, caller die khat a hloh ang.
Player die 0 a thlen chuan eliminate a ni ang. Player hnuhnung a la awm chuan a chak ang.

board.new_round:
Round thar - Dice la awm {dice_summary}
I dice hi {your_dice} an ni.

call.bidder_loses:
Player {current_player_id} in au! Face {face_value} a awm zawng tak chu {count} niin, {quantity} aiin a tlem zawk a ni.
Player {loser_id} (bidder hnuhnung ber) in die pakhat a hloh.
call.caller_loses:
Player {current_player_id} in auh a, Face {face_value} count tak chu {count} a ni, chu chu {quantity} aiin a sang bakah.
Player {loser_id} (auhtu) in a die khat a hloh.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: A hma lam bid tel lovin an ko a ni.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Action hi a ṭha tawk lo, '[Bid: X, Y]' emaw '[Call]' emaw a ni lo. Action pekte: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Thil thar {new_quantity} hi tunlai {current_quantity} aiin a tlem zawk a ni.
bid_reason.face_lower: Thil thar {new_face_value} hi tunlai {current_face_value} aiin a tlem zawk a ni.
bid_reason.identical: Bid chu tuna bid ang chiah a ni.
bid_reason.face_range: A hming lam hlutna chu 1 leh 6 inkârah a ni tûr.

message.eliminated_invalid: Player {player_id} chu tihdik lohvin a chawlhtir a ni.
